questions.explanation: Superlatives need the: the tallest.
options: She is the most tall girl.
She is the taller girl in the class.
She is tallest girl in the class.
She is the tallest girl in the class.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: The superlative of good is the best.
options: This is the best day ever.
This is the most good day ever.
This is the better day ever.
This is the goodest day ever.
questions.q: Choose the correct sentence.

questions.explanation: Happy changes y to i in the superlative: the happiest.
options: He is the most happy boy.
He is the more happy boy.

questions.explanation: Never use most with -est: the tallest is enough.
options: She is the most tallest girl.
questions.q: Which sentence is wrong?

questions.explanation: Long adjectives use the most in superlatives.

That was the most interestingest film.
